title: 受保护编辑启用入口（旧未保护 Note → d2-v1 原地启用）— fork visual evidence
synthetic_declaration: Real fork Next.js app (next dev --webpack, embedded iframe) + synthetic host page + route-mocked Research Gateway. No real RDLens host, PostgreSQL, SurrealDB, files, models, Feishu content, users or private data. All note titles/ids/content are [synthetic] fixtures (project p1, viewer 1, fabricated claims-only token).
